nodes.description: Private bool flag indicating whether minting has been finished; gates the canMint modifier.
Private bool flag indicating whether token transfers are enabled; gates the canTransfer modifier.
Address of the contract owner, set in Ownable constructor and guarded by onlyOwner.
Mapping of role hash to RoleData used by AccessControl for MINTER/OPERATOR/ADMIN authorization.
ERC20 balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 total token supply mutated by _mint and _burn.
Immutable maximum supply enforced in ERC20Capped._beforeTokenTransfer.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read/updated by transferFrom.
Deploys the token, sets decimals, mints initial supply, optionally finishes minting and enables transfers.
Public mint function guarded by canMint and onlyMinter modifiers that mints new tokens to an address.
ERC20 transfer overridden with the canTransfer(_msgSender()) modifier.
ERC20 transferFrom overridden with the canTransfer(from) modifier.
Owner-only function that permanently disables minting by setting _mintingFinished to true.
Owner-only function that enables token transfers by setting _transferEnabled to true.
Hook overriding ERC20/ERC20Capped that enforces the cap when minting.
ERC1363 transfer that executes an onTransferReceived callback on the recipient contract.
ERC1363 transferFrom that executes an onTransferReceived callback on the recipient contract.
ERC1363 approve that executes an onApprovalReceived callback on the spender contract.
Internal helper performing the external onTransferReceived call and validating the returned magic value.
Internal helper performing the external onApprovalReceived call and validating the returned magic value.
Owner-only function that transfers arbitrary ERC20 tokens held by the contract to the owner.
AccessControl function granting a role, restricted to the role admin.
AccessControl function revoking a role, restricted to the role admin.
AccessControl function allowing an account to renounce its own role.
ERC20Burnable function burning tokens from the caller.
ERC20Burnable function burning tokens from an account using the caller allowance.
Internal ERC20 mint that increases total supply and recipient balance.
Internal ERC20 burn that decreases balance and total supply.
Internal ERC20 transfer moving balances between accounts.
Internal ERC20 approval writing the allowance mapping.
Owner-only function transferring contract ownership to a new address.
View function returning the current owner address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and transfer source.
External call to IERC1363Receiver(to).onTransferReceived allowing arbitrary recipient code execution before state settles.
External call to IERC1363Spender(spender).onApprovalReceived allowing arbitrary spender code execution.
External IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer call made in recoverERC20 to an owner-supplied token address.
State mutation setting _mintingFinished to true, permanently disabling minting.
State mutation setting _transferEnabled to true, globally enabling token transfers.
Constructor tuple expression (mintingFinished == false || cap == initialSupply, "...") that is not a require, so the cap/initialSupply invariant is never enforced.

edges.reason: mint is guarded by onlyMinter, requiring the caller msg.sender to hold MINTER_ROLE.
transfer is guarded by canTransfer(_msgSender()) requiring transfers enabled or OPERATOR role.
transferFrom is guarded by canTransfer(from) which reads _transferEnabled and the OPERATOR role.
finishMinting is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == _owner.
enableTransfer is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == _owner.
recoverERC20 is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == _owner.
grantRole requires the caller to hold the admin role of the granted role.
revokeRole requires the caller to hold the admin role of the revoked role.
renounceRole requires the caller to be the account renouncing the role.
burn uses _msgSender() as the account whose tokens are destroyed.
burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == _owner.
mint recipient argument flows into the mint function.
mint amount argument flows into the mint function.
transfer recipient argument flows into the transfer function.
transfer amount argument flows into the transfer function.
transferFrom source argument is used both for the canTransfer check and the transfer.
transferFrom recipient argument flows into the transferFrom function.
transferFrom amount argument flows into the transferFrom function.
transferAndCall recipient argument is the callback target.
transferAndCall amount argument flows into the transfer.
transferAndCall data argument is forwarded to the callback.
approveAndCall spender argument is the callback target.
burnFrom account argument is the address whose tokens are burned.
recoverERC20 tokenAddress argument selects the token contract called.
recoverERC20 tokenAmount argument is the amount transferred out.
transferOwnership newOwner argument becomes the new owner.
Ownable constructor local caches the deployer address used as initial owner.
retval holds the magic value returned by the external callback in _checkAndCallTransfer.
decreasedAllowance is written to the allowance during burnFrom.
transferAndCall invokes _checkAndCallTransfer which performs the recipient callback.
transferFromAndCall invokes _checkAndCallTransfer which performs the recipient callback.
approveAndCall invokes _checkAndCallApprove which performs the spender callback.
_checkAndCallTransfer performs the external onTransferReceived call on the untrusted recipient.
_checkAndCallApprove performs the external onApprovalReceived call on the untrusted spender.
Control returns from the untrusted recipient callback into _checkAndCallTransfer before completion.
Control returns from the untrusted spender callback into _checkAndCallApprove before completion.
transferAndCall first calls the inherited transfer to move tokens.
transferFromAndCall first calls the inherited transferFrom to move tokens.
approveAndCall first calls _approve to set the allowance.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer implementation.
transfer reads _transferEnabled inside the canTransfer modifier.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer implementation.
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
mint delegates token creation to _mint.
_mint increases the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath add used in ERC20Capped cap comparison.
_mint invokes _beforeTokenTransfer so the cap is validated.
_beforeTokenTransfer compares totalSupply().add(amount) against _cap on minting.
burn delegates to _burn with the caller as account.
burnFrom delegates to _burn after reducing the allowance.
_burn decreases the account entry of _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
finishMinting executes the state write that disables minting.
State write sets the _mintingFinished flag read by the canMint modifier.
enableTransfer executes the state write that enables transfers.
State write sets the _transferEnabled flag read by the canTransfer modifier.
recoverERC20 performs an external token transfer to the owner.
The external transfer target is the caller-supplied tokenAddress parameter.
recoverERC20 sends the recovered tokens to owner().
Constructor contains a comma tuple expression that was intended as a require but enforces nothing.
The unenforced check compares cap with initialSupply, leaving the cap invariant unchecked.
Constructor mints the initial supply to the owner via _mint.
Constructor may call finishMinting when mintingFinished is true.
Constructor may call enableTransfer when transferEnabled is true.
grantRole writes membership and admin information in the _roles mapping.
revokeRole removes account membership from the _roles mapping.
renounceRole removes the caller membership from the _roles mapping.
_approve writes the owner/spender entry of the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from the _allowances mapping.
